summary: Join this Strategic Investor Relations Training Course to master the art of investor communication. Elevate your professional skills and drive business success.
lede: Investor relations training helps professionals connect corporate strategy and financial performance with market expectations. It is for investor relations officers, finance leaders, corporate secretaries, and communications and ESG teams handling financial disclosures and investor engagement. Participants learn to build consensus models, prepare earnings scripts and Q&A, and use ownership data to plan shareholder outreach.
audienceIntro: This program is specifically structured for professionals responsible for shaping market perception, managing financial disclosures, and engaging with the investment community.
modules: IR Strategy, Measurement, and Board Reporting
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of corporate finance, financial statements (income statement, balance sheet, cash flow), and basic equity market mechanics. Prior experience in investor relations, corporate finance, treasury, or financial communications is highly recommended. No advanced financial modeling or coding experience is required, but participants must be comfortable navigating spreadsheet-based financial data to fully engage with the consensus modeling exercises.
